[`DurationValue`](DurationValue.md)

## DurationValue class

[Value](docs/obsidian_docs/obsidian_dev_docs/en/Reference/TypeScript%20API/Value.md) wrapping a duration. Durations can be used to modify a [DateValue](DateValue.md) or can result from subtracting a DateValue from another.

 1.10.0

**Signature:**

```typescript
export class DurationValue extends NotNullValue 
```
**Extends:** [`NotNullValue`](NotNullValue.md)
